match.reason: No bank point teaches the global challenges of poverty, conflict, disease, climate change and unequal access, since the closest cards cover causes of local wellbeing differences, measures of poverty, or the SDG goals rather than these challenges.

draft.title: Global challenges to wellbeing
card: A global challenge is a problem that lowers human wellbeing in many places, not just one. Five big ones are poverty, conflict, disease, climate change and unequal access to education and health care.
Poverty means people cannot afford enough food, clean water, shelter or health care. Conflict, such as war, can kill people, force them to flee their homes and destroy schools and hospitals.
Disease can reduce health and stop people working or studying. Climate change can bring droughts, floods and rising seas that damage crops, homes and incomes.
When some groups cannot reach schools or health services, their health, skills and income suffer. Girls, people in remote areas and the poor are often the ones left out.
draft.remember: Poverty, conflict, disease, climate change and unequal access can all hold wellbeing back, often at the same time.

a.q: A war destroys the hospitals and schools in a region, and many families flee. Which wellbeing challenge is this mainly an example of?
a.why: War is conflict, and it harms wellbeing by killing people, forcing them from their homes and destroying services. Poverty may follow, but the cause here is the fighting, not a lack of money to start with.
a.clue: What caused the destruction of the hospitals and schools?

b.q: In a remote village, a clinic closed years ago and the nearest high school is a day's travel away. Children there often miss school through illness. Which challenge best explains why wellbeing is held back?
opts: Unequal access to education and health care
Rising sea levels from climate change
Too few people living in the village
b.why: Services are out of reach for people in a remote area, so their health and learning suffer. Climate change can harm wellbeing, but nothing here points to it.
b.clue: Look at what the village is missing.

b.best: Unequal access to education and health care
